title: Missing values: why they are missing and what that means

videos.script: An empty cell is not a value. It is a question. Why is nothing here? {{question}} Sometimes the answer is harmless. The order was collected at the shop, so nobody timed a delivery. The blank is correct. {{harmless}} Sometimes the answer depends on another column you can see. One courier never reports times. The blanks follow the courier. {{depends}} And sometimes the answer depends on the value you cannot see. A timer stops at two hours. Every delivery that took longer comes back empty. {{hidden}} Those three cases have names. Missing completely at random. Missing at random. And missing not at random, the dangerous one. {{names}} The dangerous one is dangerous because nothing in the data says so. The averages look normal. The survey score looks healthy. Both are wrong, in the same direction. {{wrong}} This lesson is about reading the pattern of the blanks, and asking the right person the right question. What to do about them is lesson 4. {{end}}
